fluff.overview: ComStar's infantry served across the Inner Sphere in garrison and security roles, stationed on HPG compound worlds where they provided protection for the Order's most critical infrastructure while maintaining the facade of a purely defensive force. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that provide good road speed and adequate armor protection for the infantry squad carried inside. Wheeled transport is cheaper to maintain than tracked or hover alternatives, making these formations a cost-effective choice for garrison duty on developed worlds with solid road infrastructure. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
